description: An untamed saddled nautilus ridden with forward held (it isn't the player's to steer); then a tame saddled nautilus in a glass tank of water: swimming forward level, up and down along the look, backward, strafing; a dash charged for 10 ticks into the wall, jump held during the cooldown, a short dash; left in a channel of flowing water (the current doesn't push it); on land: walking and a dash; sneaking off.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
